user_scope: Physical realism is the criterion. Videos inform a motion style; they are not trajectories that must be reproduced exactly. No physiological activation, fatigue or injury prediction.
validation_separation: Equation consistency, task completion and realistic human coordination are separate acceptance criteria. Passing one never implies the others.

current_task.arm_motion: One sagittal swing; fixed humeral axial rotation and neutral wrist/fingers.
current_task.leg_motion: For the bilateral sagittal task, hold planted-pose hip axial rotation/adduction and subtalar orientation. These task restrictions do not impose strength ceilings.
current_task.ground: Joint and COM objectives are soft; reaction feasibility is imposed while generating motion.
current_task.flight: COM and angular momentum inherit the launch state; only internal coordination changes.
current_task.landing: Impact and supported settling require a separate contact solve and remain pending.
